home.welcome_subtitle: May our Lord bless your journey and purify your intentions. We are delighted to accompany you on this beautiful walk in the sacred lands.
home.tefekkur_text: Before we set out, let us listen to our hearts and renew our intentions. Whoever sets out seeking only the pleasure of Allah becomes His most precious guest. All weariness fades, leaving only peace.

preparation.title: Ihram Preparation
preparation.step1_desc: Before entering Ihram, it is a beautiful Sunnah to cleanse ourselves of physical and spiritual impurities, just as we stand for prayer. As water cleanses the body, repentance washes the heart.
step1_bullets: Performing Ghusl (ritual bath) is a Sunnah.
Trimming nails and performing general body purification.
Applying pleasant perfume (For men - can be applied to the body right before entering Ihram, but not on the garments).
preparation.mark_complete: Alhamdulillah, I have completed this step
preparation.step2_desc: After purification and before the intention (niyyah), we wear the ihram garments.
step2_bullets: For Men: Remove all stitched clothing (including underwear) and wrap yourself in two pieces of clean white unstitched cloth (Rida and Izar).
For Women: There is no specific ihram clothing. Ordinary, clean, and modest clothing serves as ihram. The face and hands remain uncovered.
preparation.step3_desc: After wearing the garments (if it's not a prohibited time), perform a 2-rak'ah Ihram prayer.
step3_bullets: It is sunnah to recite Surah Al-Kafirun after Al-Fatihah in the first rak'ah.
It is sunnah to recite Surah Al-Ikhlas after Al-Fatihah in the second rak'ah.
preparation.step4_desc: After the prayer or upon boarding your vehicle, make the intention and recite the Talbiyah. Ihram restrictions begin at this exact moment.
step4_bullets: Niyyah: 'O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah, so make it easy for me and accept it from me.'
Talbiyah: 'Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.' (Men recite loudly, women quietly).
preparation.step5_desc: Once in Ihram, these restrictions apply until you cut your hair at the end of Umrah.
step5_bullets: Do not cut hair, beard, nails, or pluck body hair.
Do not apply perfumes or use scented soaps.
Do not pluck or cut the plants of the Haram (Makkah).
Do not argue, use bad language, or lose your temper.
(For Men) Do not cover the head, or wear stitched clothes, underwear, or socks.
preparation.tefekkur_title: The Secret and Reflection of Ihram
preparation.tefekkur_text: Ihram is about stripping away worldly titles, wealth, and status to realize our pure servitude before Allah. Just as we will be resurrected in shrouds and gathered equally before our Lord on the Day of Judgment, everyone here wraps themselves in the same white cloth. By the secret of 'Deeds are judged by intentions' (Bukhari), we detach our hearts from the world and bind them solely to His pleasure. To enter Ihram is, in a way, to die before dying; it is melting pride, arrogance, and worldly ambitions into that white cloth.
preparation.tips_title: Practical Tips to Secure Your Ihram
preparation.tip_1: 📌 Roll the Top Edge: After wrapping the Izar at your waist, roll the top edge outwards 2-3 times like a belt. This locks the towel securely.
preparation.tip_2: 📌 Use an Ihram Belt: Zipped Ihram belts carry money/phone while keeping the Izar firmly secured.
preparation.tip_3: 📌 Iztiba Rule: Expose your right shoulder ONLY during Tawaf (7 laps). Cover it during prayer and Sa'y.
preparation.packing_subtitle: Check the essential items to pack before departing for the Holy Lands:
preparation.pack_item_4: ⚪ Pocket Quran, Supplication Book / Dhikr Counter
preparation.pack_item_5: ⚪ Regular Medications, Throat Lozenges, Muscle Ointment

ihram_niyyah.title: Intention for Ihram
ihram_niyyah.translation: Here I am, O Allah, intending to perform Umrah.

tawaf_start.title: Niyyah & Start of Tawaf (Hajr al-Aswad)
tawaf_start.translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.

rabbana_atina.title: Dua between Yemeni Corner & Black Stone
rabbana_atina.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
rabbana_atina.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
rabbana_atina.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

talbiyah.title: The Full Talbiyah Prayer
talbiyah.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
talbiyah.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
talbiyah.translation: Here I am O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed all praise, grace, and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

tawaf.title: Tawaf
tawaf.complete: Alhamdulillah, you have completed the Tawaf.
tawaf.instruction: Circling the Kaaba 7 times, starting from the Black Stone (Hajr al-Aswad), completes one Tawaf. Each round is called a 'Shawt'.
tawaf.confirm_reset: Are you sure you want to reset the Tawaf counter?
tawaf.tefekkur_title: The Secret and Reflection of Tawaf
tawaf.tefekkur_text: Tawaf is joining the cosmic dhikr (remembrance) of the universe. Just as electrons revolve around a nucleus and planets revolve around the sun, the believer circles the Kaaba like a moth drawn to the center of their existence and faith. We accompany the angels who circumambulate Bayt al-Ma'mur in the heavens. The Prophet (pbuh) said: 'Whoever circumambulates the Kaaba becomes as sinless as the day his mother bore him.' Starting from the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad), we renew our covenant of servitude with our Lord.
tawaf.complete_subtitle: Upon completing Tawaf, follow these steps in order:
tawaf.post_step_1: 1. Cover Your Right Shoulder: Cover your right shoulder again (end Iztiba) with your Ihram sheet.
tawaf.post_step_2: 2. Pray 2 Rak'ahs of Tawaf Prayer: Pray 2 rak'ahs behind Maqam Ibrahim or anywhere in the Haram (Recite Al-Kafirun in 1st, Al-Ikhlas in 2nd).
tawaf.post_step_3: 3. Drink Zamzam Water: Face the Qibla, drink Zamzam water to your fill, wipe some on your head, and make du'a.
tawaf.post_step_4: 4. Proceed to Sa'y: Walk towards Safa hill to begin your Sa'y.

tawaf_map.title: Kaaba Tawaf Map
tawaf_map.direction: Arrows indicate the counter-clockwise direction of Tawaf. Starting from the Black Stone and returning to it completes 1 round. The 'Rabbana Atina' prayer is recited in the dashed area between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone.

sai.title: Sa'i
sai.complete: Alhamdulillah, you have completed the Sa'i.
sai.instruction: Starting from Mount Safa and walking to Mount Marwa counts as 1. We will walk between them 7 times in total.
sai.confirm_reset: Are you sure you want to reset the Sa'i counter?
sai.tefekkur_title: The Secret and Reflection of Sa'y
sai.tefekkur_text: Sa'y is the walk of immense reliance (Tawakkul) of our mother Hajar, searching for a drop of water (mercy) in a desolate desert. As we hurry between Safa and Marwa, we share in her urgency, her struggle for her child Ismail, and most importantly, her absolute trust in Allah. We know that once we do our utmost (Sa'y), it is only Allah who causes the Zamzam (mercy) to gush forth. 'Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah...' (Al-Baqarah, 158).
sai.complete_title: Alhamdulillah, Your Sa'y & Umrah is Complete!
sai.complete_subtitle: The 7th lap ends at Marwah. Follow these final steps to exit Ihram:
sai.post_step_1: 1. Supplicate at Marwah: Face the Qibla at Marwah hill, praise Allah, and make personal du'a.
sai.post_step_2: 2. Haircut / Shaving (Halq/Taqsir): Men shave or shorten hair equally. Women trim a fingertip length (1-2 cm) from hair ends.
sai.post_step_3: 3. Exit Ihram: Once hair is cut, all Ihram restrictions end. You may change into ordinary clothes. Mabrouk!

practical.title: Practical Information
practical.haircut_desc: As the final step of Umrah, men must shave or trim their hair, and women trim a small portion. Reliable and clean barbers can be found right outside the Marwa exit. You may also do this in your hotel.
practical.dining_desc: Around Masjid al-Haram, especially in the Abraj Al Bait (Clock Tower) and Jabal Omar complexes, there are many clean and reliable food courts. If you want to try a local favorite, Al Baik is a great option.
practical.ziyarat_card_desc: Explore holy visitation sites in Makkah al-Mukarramah and Madinah al-Munawwarah with historical context.

ziyarat.title: Mecca & Medina Ziyarat
ziyarat.hira_desc: The place of the first revelation, a station of reflection and seclusion. A place to step away from the world's noise and feel the deep contemplation of the Prophet (pbuh).
ziyarat.thawr_desc: The site of loyalty and absolute trust in Allah during the Hijrah. The station where the secret of 'Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us' was etched into hearts.
ziyarat.mualla_desc: The resting place of our mother Khadijah. A place to remember her infinite loyalty and support for the Prophet (pbuh) during his hardest days, and to pray for her.
ziyarat.nabawi_desc: Entering His (pbuh) presence. A station to lower even the sound of one's footsteps, sending greetings with heartfelt reverence. A garden from the gardens of Paradise.
ziyarat.quba_desc: The first mosque of Islam. A place to embody piety and revive the beautiful Sunnah of the Prophet (pbuh) who would walk here every Saturday to pray.
ziyarat.uhud_desc: 'Uhud loves us, and we love Uhud.' A station to remember the sacrifice of Hamza, the importance of obedience, and to pray for the martyrs with deep love.
ziyarat.baqi_desc: The luminous cemetery where tens of thousands of companions rest. A place to realize the fleeting nature of this world and pray for the blessed generation who brought Islam to us.
ziyarat.rawdah_desc: The area between the tomb of the Prophet (pbuh) and his pulpit is 'one of the Gardens of Paradise'. To visit this holy site, a prior appointment must be booked via Saudi Arabia's official Nusuk App.
ziyarat.rawdah_b1: 📌 Download the Nusuk app and log in with your passport and visa details.
ziyarat.rawdah_b2: 📌 Select 'Pray in Rawdah' and choose an available time slot.
ziyarat.rawdah_b3: 📌 Arrive at the assigned courtyard gate 30 minutes before your appointment.
ziyarat.rawdah_b4: 📌 As you pass the Sacred Chamber, send greetings reverently: 'As-salamu 'alayka ya Rasool Allah'.
